```python
from fractions import Fraction
from itertools import product

# Distinct physical balls, represented by (color, number).
balls = [("red", 1)] * 2 + [("red", 2)] * 4
balls += [("blue", 1)] + [("blue", 2)] * 2
n = len(balls)

# (1) Exhaustively enumerate ordered draws with replacement.
favorable = sum(
    (balls[i][0] != balls[j][0]) and
    (balls[i][1] + balls[j][1] == 3)
    for i, j in product(range(n), repeat=2)
)
p1 = Fraction(favorable, n * n)

# (2) Exhaustively enumerate ordered draws without replacement.
pairs = [(i, j) for i in range(n) for j in range(n) if i != j]
count_a = count_b = count_ab = 0
for i, j in pairs:
    a = balls[i][0] == "red"
    b = balls[j][1] == 1
    count_a += a
    count_b += b
    count_ab += a and b

pa = Fraction(count_a, len(pairs))
pb = Fraction(count_b, len(pairs))
pab = Fraction(count_ab, len(pairs))
independent = pab == pa * pb

print("(1) Favorable ordered outcomes:", favorable, "out of", n * n)
print("(1) Computed probability:", p1)
print("(1) Submitted probability:", Fraction(8, 81))
print("(1)", "CHECK PASS" if p1 == Fraction(8, 81) else "CHECK FAIL")
print("(2) P(A) =", pa)
print("(2) P(B) =", pb)
print("(2) P(A and B) =", pab)
print("(2) P(A)P(B) =", pa * pb)
print("(2) Independent:", independent)
part2_ok = pa == Fraction(2, 3) and pb == Fraction(1, 3) and independent
print("(2)", "CHECK PASS" if part2_ok else "CHECK FAIL")
print("OVERALL", "CHECK PASS" if p1 == Fraction(8, 81) and part2_ok else "CHECK FAIL")
```
